fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary criticizing Dade County grand jury practices and State's Attorney Vernon Hawthorne in connection with the acquittal of Senator Hayes Lewis on gambling-related charges. Contains extensive coverage of horse racing at Hialeah Park (including "Jockey Jimmy" selections and discussion of stewarding and rules affecting small owners), along with Miami and Miami Beach nightlife and entertainment listings/advertisements (clubs, revues, pier attractions). Also features information on the Better Housing Program under the National Housing Act, including guidance on modernization loans.
